title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Kermit?
description:
Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Kermit the Frog, through two prime ministers, the Queen and a first lady.

Adolf Hitler → Neville Chamberlain → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Michelle Obama → Kermit the Frog

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
